reason: The actual PR100 output proves24 guarded image fetches and resolved finite descriptors, but presentation froze again at55/85/112seconds. Earlier PR99 also froze, so the causal change is unisolated. Prior C++ contract fixtures and narrow binary Phi/branch inspection do not replace complete validation of emitted SPIR-V. Do not add another unrelated shader feature or rerun the same screenshot-only test.
scope: Snapshot existing uploaded PR100 SPIR-V, existing isolated-profile modules when current ELF matches, and archived pre-PR100 diagnostic modules; retain per-file SHA/mtime/group provenance. Existing profile module revision is not silently asserted.

Use installed spirv-val if available. Otherwise download the checksum-pinned Debian Trixie amd64 spirv-tools package and extract only into project scripts. No apt install, sudo, package database modification or host reboot.

Invoke Khronos validator in universal SPIR-V1.6, Vulkan1.3 strict and Vulkan1.3 scalar-layout modes separately. Record every return code/diagnostic. Optional-feature/environment errors and unsupported newer features require review; no automatic inference that an error caused the freeze.

Deduplicate identical module bytes but retain every origin. Bound file counts, byte sizes, validation execution and evidence size. Keep target/failed modules plus disassembly for a bounded subset, no raw saves or executable bodies.

No emulator rebuild or launch, renderer/source/config writes, shader cache deletion, GPU access, Ollama request, debugger, service/container restart or network settings change. Check the current candidate hash remains unchanged during the audit.
